## The backlog this map leaves

- **step 3 · issue / sale** — ⚠️ — A supply issued leaves stock but no expense entry is raised; the cost reaches the books only through the supplier bill (P2P step 4, use).
- **step 4 · count** — MISSING — No route or screen takes a physical count. Evidence: api routes/integrations.js says 'returns and stock counting are version 2'; lib/stock-store.js shrinkage() reports reason-coded losses but nothing writes a count; lib/books-period.js closingStock refuses 'automatic' because quantities on hand are not kept for it.
- **step 5 · closing stock** — ⚠️ — Manual value only; the automatic mode is refused until a count (step 4) exists.
